thread:
sara (cs): Heads-up: small group of EU onboarding tenants hit stalled embedding indexing after last night's backfill. Two customers flagged demos. Need a short customer-friendly status + RCA + mitigation/credit ASAP.
amanda (cs lead): Keep it concise and empathetic. Who can give a 2-3 line RCA + ETA we can paste? Also recommend compensation.
jon (eng): RCA (plain): a recent change removed an internal safety throttle which let the backfill run too many concurrent shard workers. One EU node saw transient disk pressure and retries compounded load, slowing indexing for a handful of tenants. Immediate fix: paused backfill, stopped retrying workers, cleared node cache, restarted a rate-limited backfill. ETA ~14-20h. Ops can run a targeted expedited reindex (~1-2h) if customer requests.
mike (ops): Confirmed: paused 02:10 UTC, resumed rate-limited at 04:25 UTC (~30% throughput). Progress steady; projected finish for affected tenants ~14-20 hours. Targeted warm-path available on request.
amanda (cs lead): Draft outbound to customers (short):

"Hi <Customer>,

Quick update from Redwood: during a scheduled indexing job last night a safety throttle was inadvertently removed, which triggered retries on an EU node and slowed indexing for a small number of onboarding projects (including yours). We paused the job, addressed the retry storm, and resumed a rate-limited backfill.

Status & ETA: your project is reindexing and we expect completion within ~14-20 hours. If you need demo-ready results sooner, reply and we can run an expedited targeted reindex (~1-2 hours); we will cover the cost for trial customers.

Compensation: we've applied one week of complimentary Dedicated credits to your account as an apology.

If you'd like a direct walkthrough, reply and we'll schedule a 1:1 with CS + engineering.

Thanks,
Amanda (Customer Success)"

sara (cs): That reads well. Jon, "safety throttle" OK as phrasing? Avoid config detail.
jon (eng): Yes, that's high-level and fine.
amanda (cs lead): I'll send to impacted customers (including the two with demos) and cc sara + eng. Also update customer-health dashboard: Impact=Indexing delay, ETA=14-20h, Credit=1 week Dedicated, Owner=amanda.
incident-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-0780 EU backfill indexing delay. Severity: P3. https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0780
mike (ops): If any customer requests the expedited run, confirm here and ops will execute warm-path and report back with completion time (~1-2h).
sara (cs): Hold warm-path unless requested by customer. Amanda, paste the outbound message here after sending and log any replies. Escalate to P2 if indexing >20h or signs of new 5xx spikes.
amanda (cs lead): Sent to impacted leads and pasted outbound here. Will update thread with replies. :thumbsup:
